# Winny French

> Winny French is an online French tutoring service based in Ontario, online across Canada. All classes run live over video call for learners of all ages across Canada: students in Grades 1–12 and adults. It covers core French, extended French, French immersion, and exam preparation for DELF, DELF Junior, TEF, TCF and TCF Canada, including the tests used for immigration and Express Entry. Small groups of up to three learners cost $25 per student per hour. One-on-one classes cost $35, or $30 each when booking more than one a week. Every new student can take a free 30-minute trial class.

## Key facts
- Name: Winny French. Operated by Winny French for Kids, a federally registered Canadian nonprofit (Corporations Canada 1687619-6).
- Location: based in Ontario, online across Canada.
- Format: live online classes over video call, one hour each. Small groups (maximum three learners) or one-on-one.
- Pricing (CAD): small group $25 per student per hour; one-on-one $35 per class, or $30 per class when booking more than one class a week; free 30-minute trial class, no strings attached.
- Hours: Monday to Friday 4pm–9pm and anytime on weekends, Eastern time. Evening slots fill fastest.
- Response time: a tutor replies to trial requests within 24 hours.
- Guarantee: A free class if there's no improvement in 4 weeks.
- Rating: 5.0 stars from 30 Google reviews, as stated on the homepage.
- Tutors: high-achieving university students and native French speakers; several hold DELF certification. Winston Burron is studying a French Specialist degree at the University of Toronto and also tutors.
- Mission: affordable, high-quality French support outside the classroom, and meaningful jobs for university students as tutors.
- Community: sponsors schools, festivals, and events across Ontario, including OAPCE (the Ontario Association of Parents in Catholic Education), the Michael Cranny Fun Fair, the Agincourt Church of God Annual Free Community BBQ, Acton's Leathertown Festival, the Cactus Festival of Dundas, Eurasia Fest, and Harvest Fest in Newcastle. The site describes the OAPCE booth as a standard sponsor.
- Contact: call or text (647) 389-4958; free-trial booking form at https://winnyfrench.com/contact

## Programs
- [Programs and pricing](https://winnyfrench.com/programs): core French and French immersion, high school and university-preparation French, DELF / DELF Junior / TEF / TCF / TCF Canada prep, adult and newcomer French
- [FAQ](https://winnyfrench.com/faq): pricing, trial, grades, group vs one-on-one, Ontario FSL, exams, hours, how online classes work
- [Tutors](https://winnyfrench.com/tutors): tutor bios
- [About](https://winnyfrench.com/about): mission and nonprofit status
- [Book a free trial](https://winnyfrench.com/contact)
